function.name: schedule_callback
function.description: Schedule a follow-up call when the lead says it is a bad time or asks to be called back, or when an agent should call them. Pass the time in the agency's LOCAL time, never UTC.

callbackLocalTime.description: Local date and time, format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS (no timezone suffix).

reason.description: Why: busy, not_ready, wants_agent_callback, language, other.
